verdict.rationale: Extend's data-handling docs say automatic retention policies 'can be configured to fit your policy'. They also offer zero data retention options configurable at the workspace level and list 'Deletion APIs for every resource', so both retention and deletion control are first-party capabilities. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how retention is configured (self-serve vs. support-driven) and of the deletion API endpoints, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: We maintain automatic data-retention policies that vary in default length by billing tier and can be configured to fit your policy. We also support zero data retention options.
Zero Data Retention · Workspace level · Parse APIs · Deletion APIs for every resource
